name: Grand chateau (Deauville villa)
description: Norman seaside chateau in the style of the Villa Strassburger at Deauville, 40 x 22 m: a stone-and-brick checkerwork ground floor under two half-timbered storeys and a steep 45 degree tiled roof with three cross gables and dormers, a round corner tower with an 11 m conical spire and a slim octagonal turret, an arcaded gallery along the front carrying a balcony, railed balconies, tall brick chimney stacks and ivy. Enterable: entrance hall, salon, library, dining room and kitchen off a rear corridor, two stair cores to eight bedrooms on two floors and an open attic.
